title: Review round 1: crypto2dev TLS integration (wolfssl-2ed)
notes: Confidence: 85% chance of missed bug. Round 1 counts: P0=0, P1=7, P2=7 (6 design-review endorsements + 1 stale comment bug), opinion=5. All 7 P1s are genuine correctness/safety/test-integrity issues. wolfssl-bvs.20 (wc_AesGcmSetKey unusable) and wolfssl-bvs.5 (global flag never reset) are the highest-impact actionable bugs. wolfssl-bvs.19 (round-trip-only TLS13 AES-GCM test) violates project test-vector discipline. wolfssl-bvs.11 (guard mismatch + no CI hook) means TLS integration tests are dead code in CI. wolfssl-bvs.1 (ssl.h layer violation) is a compilation hazard for wolfcrypt-standalone users. wolfssl-bvs.17 (data race) is formally UB. wolfssl-bvs.13 (undocumented constraint) is a maintenance trap. These are NOT bikeshed — each has an engineering failure mode. Verdict: we are NOT running out of real complaints; 7 genuine P1 issues remain open.
